column1: # Forecasts for outdoor games. A valid forecast ONLY unlocks betting outdoor totals:
# wind and temperature are not model features (see README
# forecast_utc: when the provider issued the forecast; retrieved_utc: when you fetched it;
# valid_for_utc: the time the forecast is for (must be within 3 h of kickoff by default).
# All times ISO-8601 UTC. wind_mph must be >= 0; temp_f in Fahrenheit. source is required.
